Kharge Demands EC Law Repeal and Chief Election Commissioner's Removal

Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge has demanded the repeal of a law granting immunity to Election Commissioners and the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Kharge questioned if the Election Commission is above the Constitution in making these demands.
